scope: Native 3D helper with independently checked geometry, exact flags and bounded readonly traversal.
tolerance_reason: Native f32 point arithmetic with exact found/inside flags and guards.
preconditions: Finite query data and valid bounded forward mesh BVH; nonnegative projection distance; bounded triangle/edge indices.
invariants: Independent square closest point and inside geometry; independent pseudo-normal lookup/cross product and ray equation.
Readonly buffers, result padding and inactive outputs are bit-exact.
outside_scope: Ray casts are not part of the native Ray helper.
